name: Mark Harris

accounts.evidence: The campaign site 'Mark Harris for Congress' (paid for by Mark Harris for Congress, describes him as NC-08's Congressman) links https://x.com/markharrisnc8.

notes: The campaign site URL came from the WFAE 2026 NC-8 candidate guide (https://www.wfae.org/2026-09-22/u-s-house-of-representatives-nc-8-candidates). Beware markharrisforcongress.com: it is an unrelated gambling site. The search summary wrote the handle as MarkHarrisNC8; the site writes it in lower case.

name: Richard Hudson
